tools.name: tts_create
tools.description: Text to Speech. Required: text. Optional: model (default: s2.1-pro), chunk_length (default: 300), condition_on_previous_chunks (default: true) (plus 16 more).

params.name: model
params.description: Specify which TTS model to use. Use `s2.1-pro-free` for the free developer tier. If omitted or set to an unrecognized value, the request falls back to `s2.1-pro`.

params.name: chunk_length
params.description: Text segment size for processing.

params.name: condition_on_previous_chunks
params.description: Use previous audio as context for voice consistency.

params.name: early_stop_threshold
params.description: Early stopping threshold for batch processing.

params.name: features
params.description: Optional request-scoped TTS feature flags forwarded verbatim to the inference backend. Use ['quality-guard'] to enable the quality guard for this synthesis request. Feature availability is determined by the inference backend.

params.name: format
params.description: Output audio format.

params.name: latency
params.description: Latency-quality trade-off. normal: best quality, balanced: reduced latency, low: lowest latency.

params.name: max_new_tokens
params.description: Maximum audio tokens to generate per text chunk.

params.name: min_chunk_length
params.description: Minimum characters before splitting into a new chunk.

params.name: mp3_bitrate
params.description: MP3 bitrate in kbps. Only applies when format is mp3.

params.name: normalize
params.description: Normalizes text for English and Chinese, improving stability for numbers.

params.name: opus_bitrate
params.description: Opus bitrate in bps. -1000 for automatic. Only applies when format is opus.

params.name: prosody
params.description: Speed and volume adjustments for the output.

params.name: reference_id
params.description: Voice model ID(s) from Fish Audio library or your custom models. For single-speaker synthesis, provide a string. For multi-speaker synthesis (dialogue), provide an array of model IDs. **Multi-speaker is only available with the S2 family (`s2-pro`, `s2.1-pro`, `s2.1-pro-free`), not `s1`.** When using multiple speakers, use speaker tags in your text like `<|speaker:0|>` and `<|speaker:1|>` to indicate speaker changes. Example: `<|speaker:0|>Hello!<|speaker:1|>Hi there!<|speaker:0|>How are you?` with `reference_id: ['speaker-a-id', 'speaker-b-id']`.

params.name: references
params.description: Inline voice references for zero-shot cloning. Requires MessagePack (not JSON). For single speaker, provide an array of ReferenceAudio objects. For multiple speakers, provide an array of arrays where each inner array contains references for one speaker. **Multi-speaker is only available with the S2 family (`s2-pro`, `s2.1-pro`, `s2.1-pro-free`), not `s1`.** The speaker index corresponds to the index in reference_id array. Example for multi-speaker: [[{audio, text}], [{audio, text}, {audio, text}]] for 2 speakers where speaker 1 has 2 reference samples.

params.name: repetition_penalty
params.description: Penalty for repeating audio patterns. Values above 1.0 reduce repetition.

params.name: sample_rate
params.description: Audio sample rate in Hz. When null, uses the format's default (44100 Hz for most formats, 48000 Hz for opus).

params.name: temperature
params.description: Controls expressiveness. Higher is more varied, lower is more consistent.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to convert to speech.

params.name: top_p
params.description: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling.

tools.name: voice-design_create

params.description: Specify which voice-design model to use.

params.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Higher values follow the prompt more strongly.

params.name: instruct_guidance_scale
params.description: Instruction guidance scale for prompt conditioning.

params.description: Voice design prompt. Must contain 1 to 2000 characters.

params.name: language
params.description: Optional BCP-47 language hint, such as `en`, `zh`, or `ja`.

params.name: n
params.description: Number of voice candidates to generate.

params.name: num_step
params.description: Number of diffusion steps used by the voice-design model.

params.name: reference_text
params.description: Optional text used as reference content for the generated voice.

params.name: seed
params.description: Optional deterministic seed for candidate generation.

params.name: speed
params.description: Speaking speed multiplier for candidate generation.

novel_features.name: Local render history
novel_features.description: See every past TTS render with its text, model, voice, byte count, and cost.

novel_features.name: Grouped spend report
novel_features.description: Total Fish Audio spend grouped by voice, model, or day for a side-by-side with your ElevenLabs invoice.

novel_features.name: Skip identical re-renders
novel_features.description: Hash the request and reuse a prior identical render instead of paying for it again.

novel_features.name: Clone fidelity check
novel_features.description: Render a reference phrase with a cloned voice, transcribe it back, and report word-error-rate.

novel_features.name: Pre-batch budget guard
novel_features.description: Estimate a batch's cost against your live API credit and refuse to start if it would overdraw.

novel_features.name: Compare two renders
novel_features.description: Show the cost, model, and byte deltas between two past renders.
